newsitem.title: USA: Nikko starts Yankee, corp bond trading unit.
newsitem.headline: Nikko starts Yankee, corp bond trading unit.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co International Inc, a subsidiary of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, on Monday said it has created a trading unit for Yankee and corporate bonds.
Nikko said it hired Andre Lacourciere, former corporate and high-yield trader with Ormes Capital International, as vice president responsible for Yankee and corporate trading.
John Brennan, former vice president of U.S. Treasury, corporate and mortgage-backed trading at Cantor Fitzgerald & Co, was also hired as vice president of corporate and Yankee trading, Nikko said.
Lacourciere and Brennan will report to Nikko General Manager Shiro Kaneko.
Nikko said its focus in Yankee bonds will be supranational and Japanese corporate issues. Corporate bond trading will involve investment grade, high-yield and emerging markets issues.
Separately, Nikko said it hired Frank Grausso as vice president in mortgage-backed securities and Charles McAteer as vice president focusing on Treasury security sales.
